title: 【Event Report】 University of Bristol & RIKEN AIP Joint Workshop（September 22-23, 2026, UK）
sourceName: RIKEN Center for Advanced Intelligence Project
content: From September 22 to 23, 2026, the RIKEN Center for Advanced Intelligence Project (RIKEN AIP) and the University of Bristol co-hosted the “University of Bristol & RIKEN AIP Joint Workshop.” The workshop aimed to explore recent advances in the foundations and applications of AI and machine learning. Bringing together researchers from both institutions, the workshop provided a forum to exchange ideas and foster new connections and collaborations. Workshop page: https://sites.google.com/view/uob-riken-aip-workshop/ Nihonbashi 1-chome Mitsui Building, 15th floor, e-mail: aip-koho [at]riken.jp *Please replace "[at]" with "@".
